parameters.help_en:
The suffix type of the file. By default, the type of the source data is determined by the file name extension corresponding to File.Name.

PDF files support only preview, not editing. Set the Readonly field in Permission to true.

The following file types are supported:

Spreadsheet files: et, xls, xlt, xlsx, xlsm, xltx, xltm, csv

Document files: doc, docx, txt, dot, wps, wpt, dotx, docm, dotm, rtf

Presentation files: ppt, pptx, pptm, ppsx, ppsm, pps, potx, potm, dpt, dps

PDF files: pdf
parameters.help_zh:
文件的后缀类型。默认按照File.Name对应的文件后缀名确定源数据的类型。

pdf文件仅支持预览，不支持编辑，需要将Permission字段中的Readonly设置为true。

目前支持的文件类型有：


表格文件：et、xls、xlt、xlsx、xlsm、xltx、xltm、csv

文字文件：doc、docx、txt、dot、wps、wpt、dotx、docm、dotm、rtf

演示文件：ppt、pptx、pptm、ppsx、ppsm、pps、potx、potm、dpt、dps

pdf文件：pdf
parameters.name: src_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the file. The value can contain letters and digits and cannot exceed 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 文件唯一标识，可以由字母和数字组成且不超过32个字符
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
The user information in JSON format.

The user information includes the following options:

The type of each option is String.

ID (required): the unique identifier of the user. The value can contain letters and digits and cannot exceed 15 characters in length.

Name (required): the username. The value cannot exceed 32 characters in length.

Avatar (optional): the profile picture URL
parameters.help_zh:
用户信息，以JSON格式表示。

用户信息包括如下选项：

每个选项的类型均为String。

ID（必选）：用户唯一标识，可以由字母和数字组成，且不超过15个字符。

Name（必选）：用户名，不超过32个字符。

Avatar（可选）：头像地址
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The user permission control in JSON format.

The user permissions include the following options:

The type of each option is Boolean. The default value is false. Valid values: true and false.

Readonly (optional): the preview pattern.

Rename (optional): the permission to rename files. Only the message notification feature is provided. Rename events are sent to Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS).

History (optional): the permission to view historical versions.

Copy (optional): the copy permission.

Export (optional): the permission to export PDF files.

Print (optional): the print permission
parameters.help_zh:
用户权限控制，以JSON格式表示。

用户权限包括如下选项：

每个选项的类型均为Boolean，默认值均为false，可选值为true和false。

Readonly（可选）：预览模式。

Rename（可选）：重命名文件权限，只提供消息通知功能，重命名事件会发送到轻量消息队列（原 MNS）中。

History（可选）：查看历史版本的权限。

Copy（可选）：拷贝权限。

Export（可选）：导出PDF权限。

Print（可选）：打印权限
parameters.name: permission

parameters.help_en:
The file information in JSON format.

The file information includes the following options:

Modifier (required): the user who last edited the file. The type is User.

Creator (required): the user who created the file. The type is User.

Name (required): the file name. The type is String.

Version (required): the file version number. The type is Integer.

SrcUri (required): the OSS address of the file. The type is String. The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

TgtUri (required): the OSS address to which the file is saved after editing. This value can be the same as SrcUri. The type is String
parameters.help_zh:
文件信息，以JSON格式表示。

文件信息包括如下选项：

Modifier（必选）：最近一次编辑文件的用户，类型为User。

Creator（必选）：创建文件的用户，类型为User。

Name（必选）：文件名称，类型为String。

Version（必选）：文件版本号，类型为Integer。

SrcUri（必选）：文件的OSS地址，类型为String。OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSSBucket名称，object为文件路径。

TgtUri（必选）：文件编辑后保存到的OSS地址，可以和SrcUri相同，类型为String
parameters.name: file

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notifications. Events such as renaming and user going online can be asynchronously notified to the invoker through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS), create a topic and a queue, and configure a subscription relationship. For more information, see Quick Start for Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region. The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notifications must be an internal network access address
parameters.help_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint，重命名、用户上线等事件可以通过该Endpoint异步通知给调用者。使用此功能需要先开通轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务，新建topic和queue，并配置订阅关系。具体操作，请参见消息服务MNS快速入门 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html)。

轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域，异步反向通知的Endpoint必须是内网访问地址
parameters.name: notify_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The topic name for asynchronous reverse notifications
parameters.name: notify_topic_name

parameters.help_en:
The watermark in JSON format.

The watermark includes the following information:
Type: the watermark type. 0: no watermark. 1: text watermark.
Rotate: the rotation angle of the text watermark, in radians.
Vertical: the vertical spacing of the text watermark, in px.
Value: the text of the text watermark. This parameter can be set only when WatermarkType is set to 1.
FillStyle: the transparency of the text watermark. Default value: rgba(192,192,192,0.6).
Horizontal: the horizontal spacing of the text watermark, in px.
Font: the font of the text watermark. Default value: bold 20px Serif, which indicates bold, 20 px font size, and Serif font format. Supported font formats: SimSun, KaiTi, Serif (default), Arial, Georgia, Tahoma, Comic Sans MS, Times New Roman, Courier New, and Verdana
parameters.help_zh:
水印，以JSON格式表示。

包括以下信息：
Type：水印类型。0：无水印，1：文字水印。
Rotate：文字水印的旋转度，单位为弧度。
Vertical：文字水印垂直间距，单位为px。
Value：文字水印的文字。当WatermarkType设置为1时，才能设置此参数。
FillStyle：文字水印的透明度，默认值为rgba(192,192,192,0.6)。
Horizontal：文字水印水平间距，单位为px。
Font：文字水印的字体，默认值为bold 20px Serif，即默认字体加粗，字体大小为20 px，字体格式为Serif。支持的字体格式为宋体、楷体、Serif（默认）、Arial、Georgia、Tahoma、Comic Sans MS、Times New Roman、Courier New、Verdana
parameters.name: watermark
